newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: VENEZUELA BOLIVAR ENDS FLAT IN STRIKE-HIT MARKET.
newsitem.headline: VENEZUELA BOLIVAR ENDS FLAT IN STRIKE-HIT MARKET.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed unchanged at 494.50/495.50 per dollar Wednesday in very slow trade as the market felt the effects of a 12-hour national work stoppage, traders said.
Although currency desks of the leading banks and the Central Bank were open, traders said there was very little activity on the market.
"There was no demand from end clients. It was noticeable that most corporations were not working or at not making trades," one trader said.
Traders expected demand to pick up Thursday but did not foresee and sharp change in the exchange rate.
